method: One isolated Chrome browser, serial cases; other task QA browsers/heavy CPU jobs stopped. Source re-fetch audit deferred until after measurements. No ordinary screenshots or CPU profiler during measurement. Normal pause/reload; no game clock, HP, positions or visual resolution changed.

completePool.newWaitMethod: Command start to observed ready; includes ordinary transition, preparation, polling latency.

pageBootBeforeContinue.scope: Reload to title/menu, before the Continue action. Preserved separately; not claimed as zero long tasks or attributed without a profile.

phaseRiskSample.scope: One severe case for each of six source material families; not a 60-case cold-wait distribution. Read-only timing around actual generator.next, zero-time POST_UPDATE and real POST_RENDER handoff.

limitations: Single reference machine/browser; not I14 lower-end hardware approval.
Long Tasks counts are threshold events, not a claimed zero CPU duration or full-frame GPU timing.
Only six representative cold-wait measurements; do not infer a whole-pool cold p95.
The zero Long Task result covers Rift departure and post-Continue restore. Whole-page boot to title/menu still has threshold events, preserved in coldReloadLongTasks.
